About Us:
ClickOut Media is not just a company - it's a thriving ecosystem of diverse talent from around the globe. As a proudly remote-first organisation, we've cultivated an environment where creativity flourishes, collaboration is core, and innovation knows no bounds. With over +1000 team members, our startup culture fuels our growth, making us a leading force in multi-channel marketing. We specialise in delivering best-in-class SEO & Content solutions to esteemed clients worldwide.

What Makes Us Different:
At ClickOut Media, we thrive in the most competitive search verticals, operate across every major language, and conquer platforms you've probably never even heard of. Our dynamic approach, combined with our fast-paced environment, sets us apart in the industry. We're not just here to meet expectations; we're here to exceed them, every single time. Our relentless pursuit of excellence has been the cornerstone of our continuous success.

Job Description:

We're after a Programmatic Ad Operations Specialist to support Display campaigns across our iGaming products. You'll traffic campaigns, set up creatives and tracking, and make sure every launch runs smoothly on our advertising platforms.

You'll need hands-on Ad Operations experience, ideally with Adform, because it has a steep learning curve. The day-to-day work is trafficking campaigns, implementing HTML creatives, ad tags and tracking, QAing everything before launch, and troubleshooting technical issues. Experience with iGaming or gambling brands is a bonus, not a deal breaker.

AI is a big part of how we work. The team uses Claude Code daily to automate workflows and run operations in Adform, and you'll be doing the same. You don't need to arrive as an expert, but you do need to be keen to work this way.

You'll support campaigns across EMEA, NA and APAC, work closely with internal teams and external partners, and report to our Programmatic Team Lead.


Responsibilities:

  • Manage banner ads and tags across our DSPs, including Adform and other direct networks

  • Upload and organise translated banners to our ad server

  • Generate tracking links

  • QA and troubleshoot so banners display correctly

  • Monitor and maintain correct percentage splits on direct deals

  • Run A/B tests on banners and report on how they compare

Required Experience:

  • 1–3 years in Ad Operations, Digital Advertising or Ad Tech

  • At least two years using a large DSP and ad servers (ideally Adform, but DV360, The Trade Desk or Amazon DSP work too)

  • Understanding of HTML5 creatives, third-party ad tags, JavaScript tags and VAST/VPAID tags

  • Experience implementing click trackers, impression trackers and conversion tracking

  • Experience creating and validating tracking URLs using UTM parameters and macros

  • Familiarity with pixels, conversion tracking and tag troubleshooting

  • Experience QAing creatives before launch across browsers and devices

  • Able to troubleshoot issues with creatives, redirects, tracking discrepancies and delivery

  • Good understanding of GA4, Google Tag Manager, and building basic reports in Looker Studio

  • Solid Excel/Google Sheets skills

  • Strong attention to detail

  • Able to juggle multiple campaigns at once

  • Self-motivated and highly organised

  • Excellent written and spoken English

  • Based within 3 hours of GMT (we're in the UK)

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Enough JavaScript, HTML and CSS to automate tasks like banner uploads and tag management

  • Experience with Display, Native, Video and CTV formats

  • Hands-on experience with AI coding tools, especially Claude Code, for automating workflows and troubleshooting

Benefits & Rewards

  • A brilliant opportunity to grow your career & work with a fun, fast-paced & growing company, prepared to let you shine

  • An entrepreneurial environment where you learn more every day (we more than welcome and support people with their own projects)

  • Build an organization that continues to diversify its portfolio

  • Personal responsibility with a ton of autonomy

  • 33 free paid days

  • Market-leading remuneration and bonuses available

  • An international team with over 35 nationalities

  • Fully Remote working

What do we mean by "Fully Remote"

Clickout Media offers you an unparalleled working experience. We are registered in Malta, but you don't have to be. Wherever you are based, and whether you are a contractor, operate B2B, or are a career freelancer, we will always find a way to work with great people.

Engaging with a worldwide workforce, ClickOut Media brings together world-leading experts in the fields of Tech, SEO, Content, and Product. Our remote approach gives absolute flexibility to our people and exemplifies our philosophy of autonomy and trust.

Diversity is a given to us, and this unique approach allows us to deliver and have respect for the wide variety of people, experiences, and cultures we bring together.

Cold Email Outreach Specialist (Outbound Email & Lead Generation) – Remote

Position Type: Full-Time, Remote
Location: Middle East Preferred

About the Role

At Pavago, one of our clients is hiring a Cold Email Outreach Specialist to generate qualified sales opportunities through strategic outbound email campaigns.

This is a hands-on, performance-driven role where you’ll own the entire cold email process—from building targeted prospect lists and writing personalized outreach to managing deliverability, optimizing campaigns, and qualifying inbound responses.

Success in this role comes from combining strong copywriting, technical deliverability knowledge, and a data-driven approach to consistently generate qualified pipeline for the sales team.

If you’re passionate about outbound prospecting, enjoy experimenting with messaging, and understand what it takes to keep campaigns landing in inboxes—not spam folders—this role is for you.

What You’ll Own

Prospect Research & List Building

  • Build highly targeted prospect lists using:
    • Apollo
    • ZoomInfo
    • LinkedIn Sales Navigator
    • Crunchbase
    • Similar prospecting platforms
  • Segment prospects by:
    • Industry
    • Company size
    • Job title
    • Geography
    • Ideal Customer Profile (ICP)
  • Verify and clean contact data using:
    • NeverBounce
    • ZeroBounce
    • Clearout
  • Maintain organized prospect databases and outreach lists.

Cold Email Campaign Management

  • Write personalized cold email copy, subject lines, and calls-to-action.
  • Build and launch multi-step outbound sequences (4–8 touchpoints).
  • Personalize messaging using company and prospect research.
  • Monitor campaign performance daily.
  • Continuously optimize campaigns based on engagement and reply metrics.

Deliverability & Inbox Management

  • Manage inbox reputation using platforms such as:
    • Instantly
    • Lemlist
    • Smartlead
    • Mailwarm
  • Monitor:
    • Bounce rates
    • Spam scores
    • Sender reputation
    • Inbox health
  • Rotate sending domains and inboxes to maximize deliverability.
  • Identify and resolve deliverability issues before campaign performance declines.

Campaign Optimization & Reporting

  • Conduct A/B testing on:
    • Subject lines
    • Messaging
    • CTAs
    • Send times
  • Track key metrics including:
    • Open rates
    • Positive reply rates
    • Bounce rates
    • Conversion rates
  • Prepare campaign performance reports and recommend improvements.
  • Document testing results and optimization history.

Lead Qualification & CRM Management

  • Review campaign replies and categorize responses accurately.
  • Identify qualified prospects and route them to the sales team.
  • Maintain accurate CRM records using:
    • HubSpot
    • Salesforce
    • Zoho CRM
    • Similar CRM platforms
  • Ensure outreach data remains organized and up to date.

Compliance & Best Practices

  • Ensure campaigns comply with:
    • CAN-SPAM
    • GDPR
    • CCPA
  • Maintain suppression and unsubscribe lists.
  • Follow outbound email best practices to protect sender reputation.

What Makes You a Strong Fit

  • Excellent persuasive and concise writing skills.
  • Strong analytical mindset with a focus on performance improvement.
  • Comfortable using outbound automation and deliverability tools.
  • Organized, proactive, and highly execution-focused.
  • Strong attention to detail.
  • Continuously tests, learns, and optimizes campaign performance.

Required Experience & Skills

Experience

  • 1–2+ years of experience in:
    • Cold Email Outreach
    • Outbound Lead Generation
    • Sales Development (SDR)
    • Outbound Marketing

Technical Skills

  • Hands-on experience with:
    • Apollo
    • Instantly
    • Lemlist
    • Smartlead
    • Woodpecker
    • Similar outreach platforms
  • Experience writing cold email campaigns.
  • Strong Excel or Google Sheets skills.
  • Excellent written English communication.

Nice-to-Have

  • Experience managing large-scale email deliverability.
  • Understanding of:
    • DNS
    • SPF
    • DKIM
    • DMARC
  • Experience supporting B2B SaaS, agencies, or service businesses.
  • Experience collaborating with SDRs or Account Executives.
  • Familiarity with outbound automation workflows and CRM integrations.

What a Typical Day Looks Like

  • Build and refine prospect lists.
  • Launch and monitor outbound email campaigns.
  • Review inbox health and deliverability metrics.
  • Optimize messaging, targeting, and campaign performance.
  • Qualify interested prospects and hand them off to sales.
  • Update CRM records and maintain campaign documentation.

In short: You own outbound email execution—from research and personalization to optimization and lead qualification—ensuring a consistent flow of qualified opportunities into the sales pipeline.

Key Metrics for Success (KPIs)

  • High email open rates.
  • Positive reply and conversation rates.
  • Low bounce rates and strong inbox health.
  • Consistent campaign execution and optimization.
  • Accurate CRM documentation.
  • Growth in qualified outbound pipeline.

Why Join Us?

  • Own the complete outbound email process from strategy to execution.
  • Work with modern sales engagement and automation tools.
  • Directly influence pipeline growth and revenue generation.
  • Performance-driven environment with measurable impact.
  • Opportunities to grow into:
    • Senior Outbound Specialist
    • Sales Development Team Lead
    • Outbound Growth Manager
    • Revenue Operations

Interview Process

  1. Initial Phone Screen
  2. Spark Hire Intro Video (3–5 minutes)
  3. Recruiter Interview
  4. Practical Assessment (Cold Email Sequence Exercise)
  5. Client Interview
  6. Offer & Onboarding

What Happens After You Apply

Right after you apply, you’ll receive an email invitation from Spark Hire to record your Intro Video. This short, self-recorded video is the next step that completes your application and can be recorded whenever it’s convenient for you.

Instead of repeating yourself across multiple screening calls, you’ll introduce yourself once, and your video will be shared with the hiring team. This helps the hiring team evaluate your communication style early, making future interviews more meaningful while reducing unnecessary interview rounds.

Don’t overthink it—you can record your video as many times as you’d like before submitting it. Only your final submission will be reviewed.

Please keep an eye on both your inbox and spam folder for your Spark Hire invitation after submitting your application.

Apply Now

If you’re passionate about outbound prospecting, enjoy writing high-performing cold emails, understand email deliverability, and want to help generate qualified sales opportunities through data-driven outreach, we’d love to hear from you. Apply today and become a key contributor to building a predictable outbound pipeline.

Our Story

TopDog Law is not your typical law firm. We're a nationally scaling personal injury firm built for impact and growth — owning the client experience end-to-end, from marketing and intake through litigation. We believe that world-class marketing, paired with exceptional legal talent and operations, creates better experiences and outcomes for clients and the business alike.

Over the past three years, we've grown 2–3x year over year, setting a new standard on the marketing side of the personal injury space and proving what's possible when strategy, speed, and execution align. Now we're applying that same discipline and innovation to firm operations, case management, and national scale — intentionally building the infrastructure, systems, and teams to grow without sacrificing quality, culture, or accountability.

We are a fully remote team that share trust, open communication, and a commitment to doing great work. If you love ownership, thrive in a fast-moving environment, and want to help build something exceptional, you'll feel right at home here.

The Opportunity

We are looking for a builder, not a caretaker. The Managing Attorney is the business owner of our Louisiana market, accountable for performance from the moment a case is signed through final resolution and file closure. This is not a supervisory title; it is a seat with real authority, real accountability, and real upside. The firm supplies the technology, centralized services, intake infrastructure, and regional support. You own the outcome, with significant influence over case strategy, team composition, operational cadence, state culture, and long-term growth.

What You'll Own

  • Own the state P&L: hit fee and case volume goals, align costs with growth, and bring analytical rigor to your pipeline and case mix.

  • Lead litigation and trial strategy for your state, personally taking the most complex and highest-value cases to trial when appropriate.
  • Drive settlement performance, working toward resolution within the firm's 60-to-90-day target window.
  • Recruit, develop, and retain attorneys, paralegals, case managers, and support staff, building a culture of accountability and ownership.
  • Execute firm-wide standards and operating cadences while owning the state-specific adaptations that make them work in your market.
  • Ensure full legal, ethical, and compliance oversight across every function in your state.
  • Report to the COO with regular state performance updates and data-driven KPI tracking.

What You Bring

  • Strong litigation skills, including depositions, motion practice, mediation, and trial.
  • Experience handling motor vehicle, premises liability, and personal injury matters.

raw.description:
NVIDIA’s invention of the GPU in 1999 fueled the growth of the PC gaming market, redefined modern computer graphics, and revolutionized parallel computing. More recently, GPU deep learning ignited modern deep learning — the next era of computing — with the GPU acting as the brain of computers, robots, and self-driving cars that can perceive and understand the world. Today, we are increasingly known as “the AI computing company.” We're looking to grow our company and establish teams with the most thoughtful people in the world. Are you ready to change the next generation of computing? Join us at the forefront of technological advancement.

Do you enjoy hacking and tinkering at the lowest levels of software? Are you passionate about squeezing every drop of efficiency out of complex hardware while ensuring total system stability? If so, we are searching for an outstanding Firmware Engineer to join the NVIDIA System Control Firmware team. As part of the System Control Firmware team, you will be at the very heart of NVIDIA’s Tegra SoC architecture. You will design, implement, and secure the foundational software that controls everything from basic boot sequencing to dynamic power, clock, and thermal management for world-class autonomous vehicles, AI edge devices, next-generation data centers, and advanced robotics. This is your chance to create waves in the industry while directly working alongside some of the most top-valued, diverse minds in the business.

What you’ll be doing:

  • Core Firmware Development: Design, implement, and optimize low-level C firmware for the Boot and Power Management Processor (BPMP) across the entire Tegra SoC lifecycle.

  • Active Program Support: Provide hands-on technical support to active product programs by diagnosing and debugging complex, high-priority issues, collaborating closely with cross-functional teams to drive rapid resolutions.

  • Global Collaboration: Partner closely with hardware, software, and safety architecture teams across our globally distributed engineering sites to align on requirements and system-level interfaces.

  • Debug & Test Automation: Diagnose complex hardware/software boundary failures using boot logs and hardware traces. Write comprehensive unit/integration tests and perform error injection on emulation platforms and physical boards.

What we need to see:

  • Education: BS or MS degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or equivalent experience.

  • Experience: 2+ years of professional experience in embedded firmware development, low-level C programming, and memory-mapped register access.

  • Technical Leadership & Influence: Demonstrated ability to do technical problem-solving efforts in complex projects.

  • Communication Skills: Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to articulate complex technical ideas clearly across a distributed, multi-site team.

  • AI Skills: Hands-on experience or familiarity with modern software development using AI agents or LLM-assisted workflows to enhance code generation, testing, or engineering efficiency.

  • Deep Systems Knowledge: Good grasp of SoC boot flows, interrupts, linker/build systems, and device tree-based configurations.

  • Hardware Interface Expertise: Knowledge of low-level SoC infrastructure like clocks, resets, voltage rails, and power-gating behaviors.

  • Problem-Solving Skills: Debugging skills, a self-starter mindset, a high sense of teamwork, and a meticulous approach to avoiding regressions in sensitive system behaviors.

Ways to stand out from the crowd:

  • Experience or strong professional interest in utilizing the Rust language for systems programming, safe firmware architectures, or tooling.

  • Proven background working under ISO 26262 functional safety standards and executing FMEA.

  • Familiarity with secure boot concepts and hardware/software boundary security.

  • A passion for working closely with hardware designers to influence next-generation silicon design across automotive, robotic, and data center platforms.

With competitive salaries and a generous benefits package, NVIDIA is widely considered to be one of the technology world’s most desirable employers. We have some of the most forward-thinking and hardworking people in the world working for us and, due to unprecedented growth, our exclusive engineering teams are rapidly growing. If you're a creative and autonomous engineer with a real passion for technology, we want to hear from you.

The Sales Analyst is responsible for the day-to-day execution of CRM hygiene, data integrity, and serves as a backup to frontline operational support for the Sales organization. This role assumes ownership of CRM cleanliness and operational enforcement, allowing the Sales Operations Manager to focus on broader tooling, cross-functional initiatives, and project leadership.

This role is highly operational and execution-focused, with a strong emphasis on data quality, process adherence, issue resolution, and responsiveness to Sales needs.

Core Responsibilities

1. CRM Hygiene & Data Integrity (Primary Focus)

This role takes over day-to-day ownership of CRM hygiene and enforcement from the Sales Operations Manager.

  • Own CRM data quality standards across all Sales-facing objects.

  • Execute daily, weekly, and monthly hygiene routines to ensure data accuracy and consistency.

  • Enforce expectations for:

  • Required fields and field completeness

  • Opportunity stage progression and close-date accuracy

  • Account and hierarchy usage

  • Activity logging and basic usage standards

  • Identify, triage, and remediate:

  • Duplicate records

  • Orphaned accounts, contacts, and opportunities

  • Stale or inactive pipeline

  • Incomplete, conflicting, or inconsistent data entries

  • Partner with Sales leadership and Sales Operations Manager to reinforce accountability for CRM usage and compliance.

  • Serve as the operational owner for CRM cleanliness, escalating systemic issues or automation gaps to the Sales Operations Manager and IT as needed.

  • Maintain and distribute standard Salesforce reports and dashboards to provide operational visibility (non-analytics, non‑predictive).

This scope directly aligns with known CRM health challenges and ongoing cleanup initiatives documented in Sales Operations priorities.

2. Sales Help Desk & Frontline Support (Shared Responsibility)

This role provides tier‑1 and tier‑2 support for Sales in partnership with the Sales Operations Manager.

  • Act as a first point of contact for Sales-related operational questions and issues, particularly during U.S. off-hours.

  • Support Salesforce and tool usage questions including:

  • Access issues

  • Routing errors

  • Workflow confusion

  • Basic reporting requests

  • Triage incoming issues and determine whether they can be resolved operationally or require escalation.

  • Document issues clearly and escalate to the Sales Operations Manager or IT with strong business context.

  • Maintain FAQs, internal documentation, and repeatable guidance to reduce recurring help desk volume.

  • Follow established escalation and support processes when technical intervention is required.

3. Process Execution & Operational Support

  • Support execution of Sales Operations processes such as:

  • Pipeline reviews

  • Deal hygiene checks

  • Territory or account updates

  • Tool and process rollouts

  • Execute defined operational playbooks and recurring processes with consistency.

  • Assist the Sales Operations Manager in operational projects by owning defined workstreams or execution tasks.

  • Monitor adherence to Sales processes and surface gaps or breakdowns proactively.

  • Provide feedback from frontline execution that informs process improvement and tooling decisions.

Ideal Background

  • 2–5+ years of experience in Sales Operations, Business Operations, or CRM-focused analyst roles.

  • Strong hands-on experience working in Salesforce in a Sales environment.

  • High attention to detail and comfort working in data-heavy workflows.

  • Experience supporting frontline Sales teams in a help-desk or enablement capacity.

  • Comfortable following defined processes with consistency and discipline.

Rockstar is hiring a full-time Outbound Sales Development Representative on behalf of an industrial equipment distributor that sells and services electric motors, pumps, and related equipment nationwide.

The company can sell and service accounts in every state but currently relies on in-person territory reps to generate leads. This role exists to scale that reach through the phone: the VA will cold call municipalities, schools, colleges, hospitals, and facilities managers and engineers across the country to introduce the company and open doors for the sales team. This is educational, relationship-first B2B outreach, not high-pressure selling, the company's approach is built around each salesperson acting as an educator on pumps, motors, and industrial equipment, and this VA extends that same approach by phone.

About the Client

This is a family-owned distributor of pumps, motors, and industrial equipment for water, wastewater, air, and industrial applications, in business since 1944. Known for high-quality, reliable products and strong technical expertise, they support customers across a wide range of industries, from municipalities and schools to hospitals and industrial facilities.

The company operates with a lean sales structure and no dedicated in-house cold-calling team today, this role is central to changing that and expanding their reach into new states and territories.

Key Responsibilities

  • Cold call prospective accounts, including municipalities, colleges, schools, hospitals, and facilities managers/engineers, to introduce the company and its services
  • Identify and pursue new B2B leads across a nationwide territory
  • Maintain accurate records of outreach and pipeline activity in the CRM (Bigin by Zoho)
  • Use ZoomInfo to source accurate contact information for target accounts
  • Coordinate and hand off warm leads to the appropriate sales representative for follow-up
  • Represent the company's brand and approach professionally, positioning outreach as educational and consultative rather than pushy or transactional

Tools & Systems

  • Bigin by Zoho (CRM)
  • ZoomInfo (contact and account research)
  • ServiceTitan (estimates and orders, familiarity a plus)
  • Phone and email for outbound outreach

Requirements

  • 3-5 years of sales experience required
  • Comfortable with high-volume outbound cold calling
  • Excellent, clear English communication and professional phone presence, this is a hard requirement given the technical and municipal/institutional prospect base
  • Mechanical knowledge or aptitude preferred, comfort discussing industrial equipment concepts is a plus
  • CRM experience required (Zoho/Bigin experience a plus, but experience with any major CRM is acceptable)
  • A consultative, relationship-building approach rather than an aggressive or pushy sales style

Non-Negotiables

  • 3-5 years of sales experience
  • Some mechanical knowledge or aptitude
  • Not pushy on the phone, this is an educational, relationship-first approach

Benefits

  • Competitive salary commensurate with experience.
  • Opportunities for professional development and growth.
  • Work in a dynamic and supportive team environment.
  • Make a meaningful impact by helping to build and strengthen families across the Globe

dein arbeitsumfeld

Als jüngstes Mitglied der Consileon Unternehmensgruppe steht die Opereon Consulting GmbH vor einer spannenden Zeit. Sei nicht nur ein Zuschauer – bei uns kannst du aktiv am rasanten Wachstum eines ambitionierten Unternehmens teilhaben und deinen Fußabdruck in der Unternehmensgeschichte hinterlassen. Und wer sagt, dass dies nicht auch dein Sprungbrett für eine Karriere auf der Überholspur ist?
Wir bei Opereon bieten branchenübergreifende Lösungen für Digitalisierungsprojekte – vom Mittelstand bis zu DAX-Konzernen. In der facettenreichen Welt der IT-Projekte sind wir die Spezialisten, die Ideen in die Tat umsetzen.

deine rolle bei uns

  • Software Tester: Als erfahrener Software Tester ergänzt du die meist agilen Entwicklungs Teams unserer Kunden und stellst die Qualität der Software sicher.
  • Testautomatisierung: Du nutzt Tools wie Selenium oder Appium für die Automatisierung und erstellst Unit- und Integrationstests mit Tools wie JUnit
  • Regressionstest: Du validierst auch, ob die bisherige Software im neuen Release noch funktioniert.
  • Last- und Performancetests: Du stellst sicher, dass die Software unter verschiedenen Bedingungen stabil und reaktionsschnell bleibt. Du nutzt Tools wie JMeter oder LoadRunner.
  • Fehlermanagement: Du beginnst mit der Klassifizierung der gefundenen Fehler, kommunizierst mit den Entwicklern und validierst die umgesetzten Software-Fixes.
  • Ausblick – Testmanager: Vielleicht siehst du deine langfristige Zukunft aber auch in Koordination und Management? Als Testmanager wärest du für die Teststrategie, die Testplanung, die Teamplanung und eine übergreifende Berichterstattung zuständig. Auch in diese Richtung kannst du dich – sofern du magst – bei uns entwickeln.

was wir von dir erwarten

  • Du hast mindestens drei Jahre als Software-Tester für Testautomatisierung oder in vergleichbarer Rolle in Projekten gearbeitet.
  • Du bringst einen klaren und gut ausgeprägten Tech- und Toolstack für die Testautomatisierung mit
  • Du hast Erfahrungen mit Last- und Performancetests
  • Qualifikationen in Form von Weiterbildungen als Software-Tester, untermauert mit entsprechenden Zertifizierungen (z.B. ISTQB).
  • Du bringst ein sehr gutes Verständnis für Software-Entwicklung mit, und hast selbst grundlegende Entwicklungs-Erfahrung.
  • Du hast grundlegende Kenntnisse über Datenbanken, Datenstrukturen und Datenflüsse sowie die zugehörigen Prozesse in Unternehmen.

sechs gute gründe für uns

  1. Flexibilität: Wähle wann und wo du arbeitest.
  2. Zusammenarbeit auf Augenhöhe: Bei uns zählt jeder Beitrag, unabhängig von der Hierarchie.
  3. Arbeit im Team: Bei uns bist du als Tester immer ein vollwertiger Teil des Entwicklerteams.
  4. Echte Systemkompetenz: Erweitere dein Expertenwissen zu modernen IT-Trends, Frameworks und Tools.
  5. Individuelle Weiterentwicklung: Du entscheidest, wohin es gehen soll und welche Schulungen und Weiterbildungen für dich am besten passen – wir beraten dich auf deiner Reise.
  6. Karriereperspektiven: Zeige uns, was in dir steckt und wechsle mit deiner Karriere auf die Überholspur – wir bieten dir dafür alle Möglichkeiten.

Responsibilities

The Operations Associate/Coordinator will be responsible for managing maintenance jobs from start to finish, serving as the key point of contact between clients, vendors, and internal teams. Specific responsibilities include:

  • Receiving and triaging inbound client tickets; classifying each by trade, urgency, and scope; confirming site contacts and access details; and flagging emergency situations to the dispatch team

  • Confirming job completion through photos and site sign-off; reconciling the original scope against the final invoice; and routing any punch-list items back to the vendor before closing out the job
  • Approving and submitting vendor invoices, following up on client approvals, resolving billing discrepancies, and closing jobs in the system with a complete and clean paper trail

Requirements

  • Proven ability to manage multiple active threads simultaneously across voice, SMS, and email — comfortable with 10–30 open conversations at any given time

  • Strong negotiation skills with the ability to make cost-vs-speed tradeoffs under pressure
  • Strict documentation discipline — treating compliance paperwork as non-negotiable before work begins
  • Ability to remain calm and focused in fast-paced, high-volume environments
  • Professional-level written and spoken English
  • Spanish proficiency is a strong plus

Qualifications

  • Experience in a client-facing or vendor-facing coordination role
  • Familiarity with trade industries such as roofing, plumbing, HVAC, electrical, locksmith, or general contracting is a plus but not required
  • Comfortable working independently in a fully remote environment while managing time-sensitive priorities

Benefits

  • Full-time position
  • 100% remote — work from anywhere in LATAM
  • Opportunity to be part of a growing operations platform with a clear structure and real impact
  • Collaborative team environment working alongside dispatchers, finance, vendor success, and operations leadership
  • Exposure to a fast-paced, U.S.-based operations model with strong systems and processes

  • Guide pilots, proofs of value, software validation, marketplace readiness, licensing, deployment architecture, and production transition while maintaining executive-level access to risk and progress.

  • Expertise in enterprise AI and agentic systems is vital. This includes large language models, retrieval-augmented generation, grounding, and inference. Familiarity with AI-native architectures, computer vision, digital twins, and secure deployment frameworks for enterprise and government is also essential.

  • Proven success developing strategic accounts, building pipeline, forecasting complex opportunities, and crafting business outcomes through software and ecosystem partnerships.

  • Knowledge of government buying motions, mission requirements, security and data-sovereignty considerations, funding and procurement cycles, and the partner routes to market used in public sector.

Job Description

Join Us as a Senior Clinical Research Associate – Make an Impact at the Forefront of Innovation

We have successfully supported the top 50 pharmaceutical companies and more than 750 biotechs, spanning 2,700 clinical trials across 100+ countries in the last 5 years.

As part of our global team, you’ll have the opportunity to perform and coordinate all aspects of the clinical monitoring and site management process. As a Senior Clinical Research Associate (Level I), you'll conduct remote or on-site visits to assess protocol and regulatory compliance and manage required documentation. You will manage procedures and guidelines from different sponsors and/or monitoring environments (i.e., FSO, FSP, Government, etc.). Acting as a site processes specialist, you will ensure that the trial is conducted in accordance with the approved protocol, ICH-GCP guidelines, applicable regulations, and SOPs to guarantee subjects' rights, well-being, and data reliability. You will ensure audit readiness and develop collaborative relationships with investigational sites. Detailed tasks and responsibilities assigned to your role are outlined in the task matrix.

We are seeking a Senior Clinical Research Associate to join our team in Belgium. The position can be fully remote in Belgium or hybrid/office based from our site in Brussels.

We do require previous independent monitoring CRA experience and fluency in Dutch, English and French.

What You’ll Do:

  • Monitors investigator sites with a risk-based monitoring approach: applies root cause analysis (RCA), critical thinking and problem-solving skills to identify site processes failure and corrective/preventive actions to bring the site into compliance and decrease risks. Ensures data accuracy through SDR, SDV and CRF review as applicable through on-site and remote monitoring activities. Assess investigational product through physical inventory and records review. Documents observations in reports and letters in a timely manner using approved business writing standards. Escalates observed deficiencies and issues to clinical management expeditiously and follow all issues through to resolution. May need to maintain regular contact between monitoring visits with investigative sites to confirm that the protocol is being followed, that previously identified issues are being resolved and that the data is being recorded in a timely manner. Conducts monitoring tasks in accordance with the approved monitoring plan. Participates in the investigator payment process. Ensures a shared responsibility with other project team members on issues/findings resolution. Investigates and follows-up on findings as applicable

  • Provides trial status tracking and progress update reports to the Clinical Team Manager (CTM) as required. Ensures study systems are updated per agreed study conventions (e.g. Clinical Trial Management System, CTMS). Performs QC check of reports generated from CTMS system where required.

  • Participates in investigator meetings as necessary. Identifies potential investigators in collaboration with the client company to ensure the acceptability of qualified investigative sites. Initiates clinical trial sites according to the relevant procedures to ensure compliance with the protocol and regulatory and ICH GCP obligations, making recommendations where warranted. Ensures trial close out and retrieval of trial materials.

  • Ensures that required essential documents are complete and in place, according to ICH-GCP and applicable regulations. Conducts on-site file reviews as per project specifications.

  • Contributes to the project team by assisting in preparation of project publications/tools, and sharing ideas/suggestions with team members. Performs additional study tasks as assigned by CTM (e.g. trip report review, newsletter creation, lead CRA team calls etc).

  • Facilitates effective communication between investigative sites, the client company and the PPD project team through written, oral and/or electronic contacts.

  • Responds to company, client and applicable regulatory requirements/audits/inspections.

  • Maintains & completes administrative tasks such as expense reports and timesheets in a timely manner.

  • Contributes to other project work and initiatives for process improvement, as required.

Education and Experience:

  • Bachelor's degree in a life sciences related field or a Registered Nursing certification or equivalent and relevant formal academic / vocational qualification.

  • Previous experience that provides the knowledge, skills, and abilities to perform the job (comparable to 2+ years as a clinical research monitor).

  • Valid full driver's licence

In some cases an equivalency, consisting of a combination of appropriate education, training and/or directly related experience, will be considered sufficient for an individual to meet the requirements of the role.

Knowledge, Skills and Abilities:

  • Effective clinical monitoring skills

  • Demonstrated understanding of medical/therapeutic area knowledge and medical terminology

  • Excellent understanding and demonstrated application of ICH GCPs, applicable regulations and procedural documents

  • Well-developed critical thinking skills, including but not limited to critical mindset, in-depth investigation for appropriate root cause analysis and problem solving

  • Ability to manages Risk Based Monitoring concepts and processes

  • Effective oral and written communication skills, with the ability to communicate effectively with medical personnel

  • Ability to maintain customer focus through the utilization of good listening skills, attention to detail and the ability to perceive customers’ underlying issues

  • Effective interpersonal skills

  • Strong attention to detail

  • Effective organizational and time management skills

  • Ability to remain flexible and adaptable in a wide range of scenarios

  • Ability to work in a team or independently as required

  • Good computer skills: proficient knowledge of Microsoft Office and the ability to learn appropriate software

  • Good Dutch, French and English language and grammar skills

  • Good presentation skills


Working Conditions and Environment:

  • Working Conditions and Environment:

  • Work is performed in an office/ laboratory/clinical/and/or home office environment with exposure to electrical office equipment.

  • Frequent drives to site locations. Frequent travel, generally 60-80% but more for some individuals.

  • May also include extended overnight stays.

  • Exposure to biological fluids with potential exposure to infectious organisms.

  • Exposure to fluctuating and/or extreme temperatures on rare occasions.

  • Must be able to comply with specific sponsor/client/site requirements, even if not required by Thermo Fisher Scientific (e.g., disclosure of vaccination status, or other personal information). On some occasions, this information may be required to be provided directly to sponsor/client/site.

wer wir sind

Wer Wir Sind: buah – Mission Healthy Snacks & Top-Arbeitgeber

Wir sind buah – seit 2015 ein erfolgreiches Grown-up, das es unter die Top 26 in Deutschland geschafft hat. Unsere Mission ist es, durch innovative Healthy Snacks und eine herausragende Arbeitgeberqualität Begeisterungsmomente zu schaffen.

  • Kultur & Flexibilität: Wir leben unsere Werte und bieten Dir maximale Flexibilität – im Büro, hybrid oder 100% remote. Wir unterstützen Deine individuelle Arbeitsweise.

  • Deine Chance: Werde Teil eines Teams mit Herz und Know-how, das den Snack-Markt neu definiert.

dein beitrag zur erfolgsgeschichte

Als Werkstudent:in im Bereich Supply Chain Management bist Du ein wichtiger Teil unseres Teams und unterstützt uns tatkräftig bei der Auftragsabwicklung, Koordination von Transporten und Unterstützung bei Abrufen von Rohwaren aus unserem Lager.

Mit Deiner strukturierten und eigenständigen Arbeitsweise trägst Du direkt zum Erfolg und Wachstum unseres Unternehmens bei!

Deine Aufgaben beinhalten:

  • Du überwachst täglich unsere Aufträge in unseren ERP-Systemen (Xentral, everstox etc.) und stellst sicher, dass alle Lieferungen an Kunden, Lieferanten und Handel pünktlich versendet und zugestellt werden. Zudem planst, organisierst und avisierst du Transporte an Lieferanten und an den Einzelhandel mit unseren Speditionspartnern.
  • Du bist der Hüter unserer Bestände beim Fulfillment-Dienstleister. Du prüfst regelmäßig unseren Bestand (MHD-Tracking), kümmerst dich um Umbuchungen und erfasst verlässlich Wareneingänge sowie Bestandsbewegungen.
  • Du wertest und analysierst monatlich unsere Transportkosten aus, um Optimierungspotenziale aufzudecken.
  • Du stimmst dich wöchentlich mit allen relevanten Stakeholdern zu Forecasts, Aktionen oder Sonderaufträgen ab.
  • Bei Jahresinventuren und Ad-hoc-Projekten bist du voll involviert.
  • Du übernimmst die wöchentliche Prüfung und Freigabe von Speditions- und Dienstleisterrechnungen.

was du im gepäck hast

  • Du studierst Wirtschaftswissenschaften, Logistik, Supply-Chain-Management, BWL oder einen vergleichbaren Studiengang.
  • Du bringst bereits erste praktische Erfahrung (Praktika oder Werkstudententätigkeiten) in den Bereichen Operations, Fulfillment, Logistik oder im FMCG-Umfeld mit.
  • ERP- und Fulfillment-Systeme schrecken dich nicht ab – idealerweise hast du mit Xentral, everstox oder ähnlichen Systemen gearbeitet.
  • Du arbeitest strukturiert, detailorientiert und behältst auch bei vielen parallelen Aufgaben den Überblick. Du hast ein gutes Zahlenverständnis und denkst lösungsorientiert.
  • Du bist ein Teamplayer mit Hands-on-Mentalität und hast Lust, Verantwortung für eigene Aufgabenbereiche zu übernehmen.

was wir dir anbieten können

Wir glauben daran, dass großartige Arbeit nur in einem Umfeld entsteht, in dem Du Dich wirklich wohl fühlst und Du selbst sein kannst. Deshalb haben wir eine Unternehmenskultur geschaffen, die auf Vertrauen, Gemeinschaft und echter Flexibilität basiert.

  • Echte Gemeinschaft: Ein Team, das unsere Werte atmet und sich gegenseitig unterstützt.
  • Studium & Job im Einklang: Maximale Flexibilität durch Remote-Work, Home-Office und eigenverantwortliche Zeiteinteilung.
  • Team-Highlights: Echte Verbindung trotz Remote-Fokus – inklusive unserer legendären, einwöchigen buah-Workation.
  • Impact & Mitgestaltung: Flache Hierarchien, kurze Wege und die Chance, ab Tag 1 Verantwortung zu übernehmen.
  • Moderne Ausstattung: Die neuesten digitalen Tools für reibungsloses Arbeiten.
  • Deine Benefits: Monatliche Gutscheine oder Wellpass, ein großzügiges buah-Produktbudget sowie regelmäßige Überraschungen.

wir freuen uns darauf dich kennenzulernen!

Überzeuge uns mit einem kurzen Motivationsschreiben, warum Du Teil der buah-Familie werden möchtest.
Wir freuen uns auf Dich!

At Fresche Solutions, we offer a great work-life balance with flexible hours. You can work remotely from anywhere in North America or from one of our offices—the decision is yours.

We work hard to ensure that our values are reflected in everything we do—from setting priorities and developing ideas to delivering solutions and supporting our clients.

About the RoleAs a Solution Architect, you will play a pivotal role in the design, delivery, and evolution of complex digital transformation initiatives. You will own the technical solution from initial discovery and architecture through implementation, optimization, and project completion.

This position has a particular focus on application and system performance optimization across Java, IBM i/AS400, and DB2 environments. We are looking for someone who can evaluate performance at both the application and operating-system levels, identify bottlenecks, and architect practical solutions that improve scalability, responsiveness, stability, and overall system efficiency.

You will work across multiple projects, conducting research, facilitating technical workshops, documenting solutions, and presenting and defending architectural decisions to clients and internal stakeholders. You will also act as a senior escalation point for complex technical matters and help ensure the successful completion of each project phase.

What You Will Be Doing

  • Own the technical solution throughout the full project lifecycle, ensuring alignment with client requirements, business objectives, and project goals.
  • Assess and optimize application and system performance across Java, IBM i/AS400, and DB2 environments.
  • Analyze performance bottlenecks at the application, database, operating-system, and infrastructure levels.
  • Recommend and implement strategies to improve application responsiveness, transaction throughput, resource utilization, scalability, and system stability.
  • Review Java application behaviour, including memory utilization, garbage collection, threading, connection management, and application-server performance.
  • Evaluate IBM i system performance, including workload management, job activity, CPU and memory consumption, subsystem configuration, and system resource utilization.
  • Assess DB2 database performance, including query execution, indexing, access paths, SQL efficiency, locking, database configuration, and workload behaviour.
  • Research and evaluate technical options to inform solution architecture and modernization strategies.
  • Architect solutions spanning Java, PHP, IBM i, DB2, and other relevant technologies based on the unique requirements of each engagement.
  • Translate business and technical requirements into scalable, maintainable, and supportable solution designs.
  • Lead technical discovery sessions, architecture workshops, and solution-design discussions with clients and internal teams.
  • Present, explain, and defend architectural recommendations to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
  • Produce clear architecture documentation, technical specifications, diagrams, recommendations, and implementation roadmaps.
  • Collaborate with development, infrastructure, database, delivery, and client teams to support successful implementation.
  • Champion the effective use of architecture standards, development tools, performance-monitoring tools, and delivery best practices.
  • Serve as a senior technical escalation point during discovery, development, testing, deployment, and production-support activities.
  • Balance modernization objectives with the realities of complex legacy and mission-critical environments.

What You Must Have

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Computer Engineering, or a related field.
  • 12+ years of hands-on experience designing and architecting large-scale, web-based enterprise systems.
  • Demonstrated experience as a Solution Architect, Technical Architect, or senior application architect.
  • Expert-level web application development experience using technologies such as Java, PHP, or comparable enterprise application platforms.
  • Strong experience diagnosing and resolving complex application and system performance issues.
  • Hands-on knowledge of Java performance optimization, including JVM behaviour, memory management, garbage collection, threading, application servers, and application profiling.
  • Experience assessing performance within IBM i, iSeries, or AS400 environments.
  • Strong understanding of DB2 performance optimization, including SQL tuning, indexing, query plans, access paths, locking, and database workload analysis.
  • Ability to investigate performance issues across multiple layers, including application code, database, operating system, middleware, and infrastructure.
  • Experience designing solutions for complex, integrated, and business-critical application environments.
  • Strong technical documentation, presentation, and stakeholder-management skills.
  • Ability to clearly communicate and defend technical decisions with clients, development teams, and senior stakeholders.
  • Ability to manage competing priorities and provide architectural leadership across multiple projects simultaneously.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with RPG applications and IBM i modernization initiatives.
  • Experience modernizing or integrating legacy IBM i applications with Java, PHP, APIs, web applications, or cloud-based platforms.
  • Familiarity with IBM i performance-monitoring and diagnostic tools.
  • Experience with application profiling, database monitoring, capacity planning, and performance-testing tools.
  • Knowledge of cloud, hybrid-cloud, containerized, or distributed application architectures.
  • Experience working in consulting, professional services, or client-facing delivery environments.

Cobalt Service Partners

Reports to: Regional President with dotted line into Director ofFinance

Position: Southeast Regional Finance Business Partner

Location: Remote within the Southeast, based near a major hub airport (e.g., Atlanta, Charlotte, Nashville). ~20–25% travel.

Cobalt Overview

Cobalt Service Partners is an Alpine Investors-backed platform acquiring access-solutions businesses: access control, video surveillance, alarm, and commercial door systems. We partner with founder-led companies, honor their legacies, sharpen operations, and grow through high-velocity M&A.

Position Overview

We’re looking for a hands-on, strategic finance leader to partner with a Regional President across four to five acquired partner companies — a roughly 50/50 blend of controllership and FP&A. You’ll flex to hands-on close and accounting transitions at more recently acquired companies and to forward-looking planning where teams are more established, driving margin, cash flow, and better decisions along the way.

What You'll Do

  • Serve as the finance partner to the Regional President: monitor performance, drive margin and EBITDA expansion, and turn analysis into decisions.
  • Own budgeting, reforecasting, variance analysis, and flash reporting on Revenue and Adjusted EBITDA across the region.
  • Oversee monthly close for the partner companies (GAAP, on time), including the transition from cash to accrual accounting.
  • Own cash flow forecasting and working capital across the region.
  • Lead ERP implementation and system integrations, standardizing process across companies.
  • Maintain internal controls and compliance, and support integration and audits with the HoldCo finance team.

What You Bring

  • 7–12+ years in finance and accounting spanning both FP&A and controllership; bachelor’s in Accounting or Finance. CPA or CMA preferred.
  • Multi-entity, regional, or decentralized experience - ideally in a PE-backed or acquisitive environment - with real ownership of close, reporting, and variance analysis.
  • Strong GAAP, budgeting, forecasting, modeling, and cash flow / working-capital fundamentals.
  • Comfortable in ERP-level, multi-entity environments, with the flexibility to learn and build process across systems (Sage Intacct a plus). Percentage-of-completion / job-costing experience is a plus.
  • A trusted partner who can lead and mentor finance staff and influence senior operators without direct authority.

What We Offer

  • Competitive base salary (actual offer based on experience).
  • PTO & Paid holidays.
  • Comprehensive benefits package including health, dental, and vision insurance.
  • 401(k) with company match.
  • Professional development opportunities.
  • A dynamic, growth-oriented environment backed by a leading PE sponsor.

Our Values

Unwavering stewardship: We believe advancing founders’ legacies is a privilege. We do right by our founders, teams, and customers in good times and in bad.

Excellence in action: We hold ourselves accountable to the highest standards. We’re bold in our pursuits, don’t make excuses, and relentlessly empower each other to get the job done.

Seek and tell the truth: We are honest with ourselves and others. We do what we say we’ll do, say what needs to be said, and search for the right answer regardless of where it comes from.

Love learning: We are always learning as individuals, as a team, and as a business. We show up humble, curious, and with the courage to change our minds.

Enjoy the ride: We are fired up by our mission, love our team, and don’t take either for granted. We show up authentically, assume best intent, and try not to take ourselves too seriously.

Diversity, Equity, & Inclusion at Cobalt

Cobalt is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. Guided by our PeopleFirst philosophy — which emphasizes attributes over experience — we welcome applicants of every background and evaluate them without regard to race, color, religion, sex (including pregnancy and related conditions), gender, gender identity or expression, national origin, ancestry, age (40 or over), disability, medical condition, marital or domestic-partner status, sexual orientation, genetic information, military or veteran status, or any other basis protected by law.

raw.description:
Job Title: Full Stack Engineer

Location: Full-Time, Remote

Working Hours: US Hours - EST

About the Role

Our client is a fast-growing marketing agency serving over 150 home service businesses. They specialize in performance-driven campaigns and are heavily investing in AI and automation to improve lead generation, tracking accuracy, and operational efficiency.

They are looking for a hands-on Full Stack Engineer with proven experience in marketing/ad tech environments to build and scale internal systems that directly support campaign performance and revenue operations.

This is a builder role, not a strategy-only position.

You will develop internal tools, integrate AI into marketing workflows, and improve how the agency operates across ad platforms, tracking systems, and CRM-driven pipelines.

You’ll work closely with leadership, media buyers, and operators to turn ideas into production-ready systems that directly impact campaign performance and lead conversion.

Key Responsibilities

1. Internal Tool Development (Primary Focus)

  • Build and deploy internal tools using Next.js, React, and Python
  • Develop marketing dashboards, reporting systems, and operational tools
  • Replace manual workflows with scalable, automated solutions

2. Marketing Data, Tracking & Attribution (Core Focus)

  • Implement and optimize Meta Pixel and Conversion API (CAPI)
  • Ensure accurate event tracking, deduplication, and attribution
  • Build pipelines connecting ad platforms → backend systems → dashboards
  • Develop reporting systems that enable campaign optimization (ROAS, CPL, conversion quality)

3. AI Integration in Marketing Workflows

  • Apply AI to real marketing use cases such as:
    • Ad copy and creative generation
    • Lead scoring and qualification
    • Campaign insights and reporting automation
  • Work with APIs such as OpenAI and similar AI platforms
  • Build AI systems embedded into live marketing and operational workflows

4. CRM & Lead Lifecycle Automation (Critical)

  • Integrate and automate CRM systems such as GoHighLevel, Close CRM, HubSpot, or similar
  • Build systems connecting lead capture → CRM → follow-ups → conversion tracking
  • Implement automations including lead routing, pipeline management, and conversion syncing (offline events/CAPI)
  • Ensure data consistency between ad platforms and CRM outcomes

5. Rapid Execution & Iteration

  • Ship quickly, test, and iterate based on real campaign data
  • Collaborate with media buyers to solve campaign and operational bottlenecks
  • Continuously improve systems that impact marketing performance and efficiency

Requirements (Non-Negotiable)

  • 4–6+ years of hands-on software engineering experience
  • Strong full-stack skills (React / Next.js + Python)
  • Proven experience building and deploying production-level tools and systems
  • Experience working with APIs, webhooks, and automation systems
  • Active use of AI tools in day-to-day work
  • Hands-on experience working in marketing or ad tech environments (agency or performance marketing preferred)
  • Experience implementing or working with Meta Pixel and/or Conversion API (CAPI), including event tracking, deduplication, and attribution
  • Experience building dashboards or reporting systems for marketing campaigns (e.g., Meta Ads performance)
  • Hands-on experience integrating and automating CRM systems (e.g., GoHighLevel, Close, HubSpot, or similar)
    • Including lead capture, routing, pipeline management, and conversion tracking
    • Experience connecting ad platforms with CRM systems for attribution and reporting
  • Builder mindset with a strong bias toward execution

Nice to Have

  • Experience working in a performance marketing agency environment
  • Familiarity with paid media metrics (ROAS, CPL, CAC, conversion rates)
  • Experience with tools like Zapier, Make, or similar automation platforms
  • Understanding of data pipelines and attribution challenges (e.g., iOS/privacy changes)

What Success Looks Like

  • Internal tools actively used by media buyers and operators
  • Reduced manual work across campaign and CRM workflows
  • Accurate and reliable tracking and attribution across systems
  • Faster execution of campaigns and reporting
  • AI-driven systems improving lead quality, conversion rates, and efficiency

Interview Process

  • Initial Phone Screen
  • Video Interview with Pavago Recruiter
  • Client Interview
  • Offer & Background Verification

raw.description:
tldr; We build software for Airbnbs to rent themselves, with a state-of-the-art product and user experience.

We are bold, like risks, and take on big challenges together. We believe in the value of team diversity and seek candidates from a wide range of backgrounds in their work, life, culture, and experiences. We have crafted an Applicant Handbook, which we highly recommend you check out, where you can find out more about the company, culture, how we recruit, what we do, and how we do it:

Our customers love the product, provide valuable feedback, and trust us to rapidly help with their problems. Feel free to check out one of our public Town Halls for yourself:

Hospitable.com is a remote-only and fully distributed company. We hire based on timezones, not countries.

What will you be working on?

  • Partnering with Enterprise prospects to understand their business, challenges, and growth goals through Google Meet, email, live chat, and phone.
  • Managing complex sales opportunities from first conversation through negotiation and close.
  • Prospecting into strategic accounts and building your own pipeline alongside inbound opportunities.
  • Leading tailored product demonstrations and executive-level presentations for multiple stakeholders.
  • Becoming a trusted advisor and product expert for software that is constantly evolving.
  • Managing your pipeline and forecast accurately in HubSpot.
  • Collaborating with Product, Marketing, Customer Success, and Onboarding to deliver an exceptional buying experience.
  • Creating and testing new outbound messaging, sequences, and sales plays to improve conversion.
  • Smashing through quarterly revenue targets while maintaining a consultative, customer-first approach.
  • Knowing that Allison’s favorite fruit is Papaya.
  • Understanding the operational challenges of professional short-term rental managers and bringing that feedback back to the team.
  • Working closely with our onboarding team to ensure a smooth transition from signed contract to successful launch.
  • Have an idea that could improve the way we sell? Bring it. We’ll help make it happen.

Providing feedback on our sales process so we continue getting better as we grow.

What does the schedule look like?

For this position, we are mostly aiming for the North American time zones (PT/ET). This role will be reporting Monday through Friday.

Requirements

Caring about the impact your work has on your team, your customers, and the company.

  • 3-5 years of hands-on experience in Enterprise B2B SaaS sales.
  • A proven track record of managing complex sales cycles with multiple stakeholders.
  • Attention to detail and a constant drive to improve your craft.
  • Very special kudos if you’re an Airbnb host or have experience working with short-term rental businesses.

If you’re hesitant to apply because you don’t meet every qualification, we’d still love to hear from you if:

  • You have experience selling complex, solution-based software.
  • You know how to navigate long sales cycles and multiple decision makers.
  • You have experience prospecting and creating your own pipeline through outbound.
  • You’re not afraid to challenge the status quo and suggest better ways of doing things.
  • You actively seek feedback and use it to improve.
  • A script? You’d rather understand the customer than memorize one.
  • You enjoy turning skeptical buyers into long-term customers.
  • You thrive in a flat organization where ownership and initiative matter more than hierarchy.
  • You have native or bilingual proficiency in English, both written and spoken.
  • Experience with HubSpot, Intercom, Airbnb, short-term rentals, vacation rentals, or startups is a plus.

Benefits

The company itself is also a product, one that we iterate on. We're always improving and creating an environment where we all love to work.

  • A supportive, radically transparent, and caring team environment, where you are trusted, not managed—and a culture that is focused on results and output.
  • The total budget for this role is within USD$101,000.00 - $127,600.00 depending on the cost of living in your location. We can hire talent internationally as contractors—or employees if you are based in the United States, the European Union, or Australia, taking into account payroll taxes to determine your gross compensation. For US employees, the compensation could be between USD$93,097.15 to $117,615.80.
  • On top of the base compensation, there is a quarterly commission structure of 100% of the new business MRR brought in for any given quarter provided that you meet the quarterly target of closed deals—with the possibility of earning USD$80,000.00 of commission per year.
  • We also offer options into the company equity through our $HOST token (RSU's), with a grant value of up to $23,200.00, to share in the long-term upside value of the company.
  • Separately, this role is eligible for up to an additional USD $316,452.00 per year in Performance Share Units (PSUs). These PSUs do not vest over time and are granted only upon the achievement of clearly defined business performance targets. The size and payout of this award are directly tied to measurable outcomes and are intended to strongly align compensation with company impact.
  • 35 days off per year, encouraged (including self-serve public holidays) and parental leave.
  • For US employees: healthcare (including EPO, PPO and HSA), 401(k).
  • Complimentary mental health and emotional support with therapists on call through Slack by Spill.
  • Earn virtual coins through our peer recognition platform and redeem them through gift cards, donations, or monetary rewards.

$38,500.00 - $71,000.00

Salaried

At BMO we are driven by a shared Purpose: Boldly Grow the Good in business and life. It calls on us to create lasting, positive change for our customers, our communities and our people. Some sales roles ask you to maintain business. This one invites you to build something bigger. You'll own growth across an established portfolio of consumer health products while creating opportunities that expand reach, strengthen partnerships, and deliver meaningful impact. Every new account you win, every relationship you deepen, and every milestone you achieve becomes part of your professional legacy. You'll experience the excitement of turning ambition into measurable success while helping more people discover products that support healthier lives. You'll work with the freedom to pursue opportunities, move quickly, and make decisions that directly influence growth. This is a role where ownership is earned through action and results. You'll help reshape the future of supplement sales by setting a new standard for commercial excellence, partnership, and execution. If building momentum, creating lasting relationships, and delivering exceptional performance is what motivates you, you'll find purpose here every day. Director of Supplement Sales

ROLE SNAPSHOT

  • Pay: Base + Commission
  • Location/Schedule: Remote, Full-Time
  • Purpose: Own revenue growth across wholesale, retail, broker, distributor, and direct-to-consumer supplement sales channels.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Own and achieve defined revenue targets across all supplement sales channels.
  • Drive year-over-year revenue growth through disciplined sales execution.
  • Expand national, regional, natural products, and independent retail distribution.
  • Develop new accounts while strengthening existing customer relationships.
  • Build, lead, and optimize broker and distributor partnerships.
  • Partner with internal teams to maximize DTC revenue and promotional effectiveness.
  • Prioritize the highest-value sales opportunities and execute rapidly.
  • Monitor forecasts, pipeline health, sales reporting, and overall commercial performance.

MUST-HAVE QUALIFICATIONS

  • Leadership experience selling consumer packaged goods within supplements, nutraceuticals, food & beverage, or consumer health.
  • Proven success driving revenue through retail, wholesale, and/or direct-to-consumer channels.
  • Experience managing broker networks and distributor relationships.
  • Demonstrated history of exceeding revenue targets with measurable business results.
  • Strong understanding of retail economics, pricing, margins, and channel strategy.
  • Identifies as a sales leader first, with a passion for revenue generation and execution.

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

  • Supplement or nutraceutical industry experience.
  • Existing relationships with major natural product, specialty, regional, or national retailers.
  • Experience scaling brands through broker-led distribution.
  • Familiarity with Shopify or direct-to-consumer supplement businesses.
  • National or multi-region sales leadership experience.

WHAT WE OFFER

  • Opportunity to own revenue for an established consumer health portfolio.
  • High-impact leadership role with significant commercial ownership.
  • Cross-functional collaboration with marketing, operations, and logistics.
  • Ability to influence growth strategy across multiple sales channels.
  • Environment focused on accountability, execution, and measurable results.

Honest Challenge This role is built for someone who wants to own the number. Success is measured by revenue growth, expanded distribution, stronger partnerships, and consistently delivering results. Completing the short application is the first step in demonstrating that ownership mindset. PLEASE NOTE: While we appreciate candidates who reach out directly, given the volume, we are unable to respond to each inquiry individually. The pay for this position is Base + Commission. Please note that the quoted pay range for this job is a general guideline only and not a guarantee of compensation or salary. Additional factors considered in extending an offer include (but are not limited to) experience, including industry or specific experience, education, knowledge, skills, and abilities, as well as internal equity, alignment with market data, and/or other applicable laws. This position is benefits-eligible. Mercola provides competitive, affordable, and diverse benefit programs that support your total health – from a healthy body to a healthy mind. These benefits support you and your family in all aspects of life:

  • Medical, Dental, and Vision coverage
  • Accident, Hospital Indemnity, and Critical Illness
  • Employee Assistance Program (EAP)
  • Employer Paid Life and AD&D Insurance
  • Optional Supplemental Life and AD&D Insurance
  • Short- and Long-Term Disability Insurance
  • Flexible Spending Accounts
  • Health Savings Accounts
  • Dayforce Wallet – get paid as you earn
  • Employee Discount

  • Wellness Program Offerings
  • Paid Time Off, accrued per pay period based on years of service, starting at 25 days annually.

The ideal candidate brings executive presence, strong RCGTH industry knowledge, and a proven ability to lead strategic opportunities from initial engagement through close.

About Argano
Argano is a digital consultancy that helps organizations improve performance through strategy, transformation, and technology. Through its Microsoft Business Unit, Argano delivers expertise across AI, Business Applications, Security, Azure, Data, and Modern Work to help clients accelerate business outcomes.

Key Responsibilities

  • Develop and execute a strategic sales plan to grow Argano's RCGTH business within the Microsoft Business Unit.
  • Build and advance a qualified pipeline through targeted business development and executive relationship management.
  • Lead complex sales pursuits focused on business transformation outcomes.
  • Position the full Microsoft stack, with emphasis on AI, Business Applications, Security, Azure, Data, and Modern Work.
  • Engage RCGTH clients with insight into industry priorities, challenges, and transformation opportunities.
  • Collaborate with internal leaders, solution teams, and Microsoft stakeholders to shape account strategy and proposals.
  • Lead executive-level client discussions, commercial negotiations, and deal progression through close.
  • Meet or exceed assigned revenue, pipeline, and growth objectives.

Qualifications

Education

  • Bachelor's degree in Business, Marketing, Finance, Accounting, or related field, preferred.

Experience

  • Minimum 10 years of professional sales experience selling complex business and technology services.
  • Proven success selling to economic buyers and senior decision-makers within RCGTH organizations.
  • Demonstrated ability to exceed targets in enterprise, consultative sales environments.
  • Experience selling Microsoft solutions, especially AI, Business Applications, Security, and cloud platform offerings.
  • Strong CRM, pipeline management, and account planning discipline.

Core Competencies

  • Strategic Sales Leadership: Ability to build pipeline, shape account strategy, and lead complex pursuits to close.
  • RCGTH Industry Knowledge: Understanding of RCGTH priorities, operating models, and transformation drivers.
  • Executive Communication: Ability to engage credibly with senior executives, economic buyers, and cross-functional stakeholders.
  • Microsoft Solution Selling: Ability to position the value of AI, Business Applications, Security, Azure, Data, and Modern Work.
  • Relationship Management: Ability to build trusted relationships across clients, partners, and internal teams.
  • Commercial Acumen: Sound judgment in deal strategy, negotiation, and business value alignment.

SKILL REQUIREMENTS

  • Sales Acumen: Ability to meet and exceed targets. Strong understanding of the sales process and ability to navigate complex sales cycles.
  • Industry Knowledge: Stay informed about industry trends and competitors.
  • Relationship Building: Exceptional interpersonal skills with the ability to build and maintain strong client relationships.
  • Analytical Skills: Data-driven mindset with the ability to analyze sales performance metrics.
  • Strategic Thinking: Develop and execute strategic account plans.
  • Communication Skills: Excellent verbal and written communication skills. Ability to articulate complex ideas clearly and persuasively.
  • Relationship Building: Establish and nurture relationships with potential clients. Collaborate with internal teams to provide effective solutions.
  • Negotiation Skills: Strong negotiation skills to close deals that are mutually beneficial. Ability to handle objections and resolve conflicts.
  • Problem-Solving: Identify client challenges and propose effective solutions. Collaborate with internal teams to address client needs.

Equal Opportunity Employer
Argano is an equal opportunity employer and is committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. All employment decisions are made without regard to any legally protected characteristic.

raw.excerpt: About us HighLevel is an AI-powered business operating system that gives agencies, entrepreneurs and SMBs the infrastructure to build, automate and scale.
raw.description:
About us
HighLevel is an AI-powered business operating system that gives agencies, entrepreneurs and SMBs the infrastructure to build, automate and scale. Today, HighLevel supports SMBs across 150+ countries, fueling community-driven growth rooted in real customer outcomes.
To date, businesses operating on HighLevel have generated over $7 billion in ecosystem value, demonstrating the impact of shared infrastructure at scale. By centralizing conversations, automation and intelligence into one system, we help businesses move faster, reduce complexity and execute efficiently.
Behind the platform, HighLevel powers more than 4 billion API hits and 2.5 billion message events daily. With 250 terabytes of distributed data, 250+ microservices and over 1 million domain names supported, our architecture is built for performance, resilience and long-term scalability.

Our people
With over 2,000 team members across 10+ countries, HighLevel operates as a global, remote-first organization built for speed and ownership. We value initiative, clarity and execution, creating space for ambitious people to build systems that support millions of businesses worldwide. Here, innovation thrives, ideas are celebrated and people come first, no matter where they call home.

Our impact
Every month, HighLevel enables more than 1.5 billion messages, 200 million leads and 20 million conversations for the more than 1 million businesses we support. Behind those numbers are real people building independence, expanding opportunity and creating measurable impact. We’re proud to be a part of that.
Learn more about us on our YouTube Channel or Blog Posts

Who You Are:

As the Manager of the Trial Experience Team, you will be at the forefront of having value driven conversations with customer-facing employees and leads. You will lead and develop your team, bringing strategic thinking and organization to the role. You will monitor and drive your team’s KPIs, thriving in a high-accountability environment and leveraging your expertise in managing individuals and teams.

As a passionate people leader, you will jump at the opportunity to create consistent business processes and support the team by guiding them toward their goals with the HighLevel platform. You will ensure exceptional engagement from the start of trials and foster a results-oriented, collaborative environment. By developing a team of knowledgeable experts, you will provide customers with strategic insights, ensuring their success and alignment with business strategies.

What You’ll Be Doing:

  • Influence others, lead, coach and empower, through motivation and encouragement, to accomplish team goals and foster a positive team culture.

  • Lead to ensure your team is successful by coaching, developing, inspiring and holding them accountable against established KPIs, policies and procedures - measure and provide detailed analysis on success against team’s growth KPIs and metrics.

  • Support and identify process improvements and alternative solutions to drive team efficiency, productivity and engagement

  • Being able to interpret data that translates into action to improve the team

  • Conduct consistent and impactful performance conversations, conflict management, constructive/subjective feedback, and coaching with team members, leads, and managers while fostering a high-performance culture that inspires the desire to succeed.

  • Responsible for providing your teams with technical resources and advice, resolving problems, and disseminating advisories, warnings, and corrective action plans when warranted.

  • Developing and issuing warnings and corrective action plans, as required.

  • Effectively build the morale of a group in a team setting that fosters the successful completion and achievement of team goals.

  • Serve as an influential leader by demonstrating professionalism, operating in a fast-paced environment, taking ownership of your team’s success, and fostering a team culture of encouraging growth, innovation, and proactive problem solving.

  • Lead any escalation concerns high-severity issues encountered by customers and team members, whether originating from within the team, directly from customers, or from other HighLevel departments.

  • Be readily available with cameras on throughout the shift to assist customers and team members via Zoom.

  • Other duties may be assigned and/or modified as business needs change.

What You’ll Bring:

To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform each essential duty satisfactorily. The requirements listed below are representative of the knowledge, skill, and/or ability required. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.


Experience/Education/Certifications Required:

  • Bachelor’s Degree or Equivalent SaaS Experience is strongly preferred

  • 5+ years of progressive experience leading fast-paced, results driven, customer-facing teams for a SaaS or Product-Led Growth startup company preferred

  • 3+ years of experience with staffing/hiring, performance management, career conversations, coaching and developing front-line employees and junior managers required

  • You are a true people manager at heart, you love mentoring, leading and contributing to the professional development of those around you

  • A strong technical aptitude to help our users succeed with the HighLevel software

  • Strong collaboration, time-management and prioritization skills are critical to the success of this role

  • The ability to build and maintain strong relationships internally with senior leadership, teams and customers

  • Strong experience using data/analytics tools to solve problems, measure the impact of your work, develop new projects and drive demonstrable customer and team success

  • Ability to collaborate and influence cross-functional teams and champion new concepts and ideas

  • Demonstrated approach to problem solving and conflict management

  • Must be a go-getter, not afraid to ask questions, and take accountability for your results and your team’s results

  • Demonstrated experience to learn quickly and apply new technologies to solve problems and bring these lessons to a team of direct reports

  • Ability to develop and maintain deep knowledge of customers, data, business, and markets

  • Demonstrated ability to communicate well with colleagues, subordinates, and customers, both written and oral

  • Experience working with and or ability to learn the use of various CRM Systems

  • Working knowledge of topics such as Social Media Management, Social Media Advertising, Website/Funnel Building, and SEO

  • Working Knowledge of the following applications: Google Suite, Zoom, Facebook, Instagram, Slack, Linkedin and other social media
